description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
Universal Automaton enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Lathliss.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Universal Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Dragon you control.
Repeat.
